name: Diamond Easy
summary:
**Diamond Easy** brings the relaxing craft of diamond painting into VR. Pick a colour, place sparkling diamonds and watch your artwork come to life.

No timers. No pressure. Just settle into your cosy space and create at your own pace.

## ✨ A satisfying craft in VR

Pick up your pen, choose your diamonds and place them directly onto the canvas.
